args.old_text: Join us this Saturday for our monthly Repair Cafe! Bring your broken household items, from toasters to lamps, and our volunteer repair experts will help you fix them. The cafe opens at 10 a.m. sharp, so don't be late! It's a great way to save money and reduce waste.
args.new_text: We're excited to see you this Saturday, 10 a.m., for our monthly Repair Cafe! Bring a broken lamp or other household items, and our volunteer repair experts will help you fix them. Please note, all repairs are free. It's a great way to save money and reduce waste.
